name: Windows Time Synchronized from a Network Source
description:
Ensures the Windows Time service is synchronizing from a network time source rather than the local CMOS clock or a free-running clock (w32tm /query /status).
Required Windows permission: the LEA agent account must be allowed to run w32tm /query /status (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

re.stdout: (?m)^Source:[ \t]*(?!Local CMOS Clock|Free-running System Clock|VM IC Time Synchronization Provider)\S
